description: This file defines a partial class 'AdminQueue' for the web page 'AdminCourseQueue.aspx'. It manages the admin queue for courses, including session validation, database checks for course queue entries, and navigation controls such as home, profile, leaderboard, and logout. It also processes grid view selection to transfer to answer display page.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminCourseQueue.aspx page, handling session validation, database operations related to course queue, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; checks session variables, verifies course queue in database, and potentially deletes entries if queue is empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for the home button, navigates to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for the profile button, reloads the current page 'AdminQueue.aspx'.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for the leaderboard button, navigates to AdminLeaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for the logout button, navigates to LoginPage.aspx.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection change in GridView; sets session variables based on selected row and transfers to ShowAns.aspx.
